channel.title: Thai Regulatory Watch — regulatory
channel.description: Public observations for review. Newest source publication first, falling back to source modification. Undated items follow dated items; no pubDate is invented. Date-only pubDate uses midnight UTC for presentation, not a known publication time. Regulatory source coverage: 10/15 healthy. Incomplete coverage: pdpc-laws, pdpc-announcements, pdpc-official-consultations, pdpc-official-orders, tcct-official-complaints-prosecution. No new feed entries is not proof of no regulatory updates. Legal effect is Not assessed. RSS window: 500. Full history: https://attorneynoon.github.io/thai-regulatory-watch/api/v1/events.json
